**💡 Today's learning:** "Going out with wet hair gives you a cold"
- **🤔 What people believe:** Stepping out with wet hair, or getting chilly, makes you catch a cold.
- **🔬 The fact:** A cold needs a virus, most often a rhinovirus. Cleveland Clinic says you cannot get sick from simply going outside with wet hair; colds rise in winter because viruses spread better in cold air and people crowd indoors.
- **🎯 How they fool you:** Nobody sells this one; it is a family warning. You feel cold first and the sniffles show up later, so the chill gets the blame instead of the germ you picked up from someone nearby.
- Source: https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-wet-hair-make-you-sick
